sources.m10_r12_modifications: M10-R12: context-checked native blade depression, height-aware tongue-tip retraction, posterior/upper circle tangent selection without angle wrap, and anterior ventral return for curled poses. sources.m10_r13_modifications: M10-R13: stable auxiliary tip height, tangent-continuous depressed blade, curvature-weighted native ribs for a rounded raised tip, denser circular target and tangent-aligned ventral return. Native surfaces and tube recalculated together; topology and file formats unchanged. Original API DLLs/speakers preserved; GPL-3.0-or-later.
sources.m10_r14_modifications: M10-R14: continuous raised/curled tip radius compensation, posterior arc attachment for finite tip thickness, native material blade rib export, and 257 longitudinal sections (96 transverse samples). Same native geometry feeds tube recomputation. Reference 129-section build retained for measured timing/area comparisons. Original API DLLs/speakers preserved; GPL-3.0-or-later.
sources.m10_r15_modifications: M10-R15: fixed-capacity native arrays with runtime 65/129/257 cross-section counts and matching centerline exponent. Default 129; 257 option compared against the unmodified R14 257 capture. Real geometry, tube integrals and transfer function follow the selected resolution. Original API DLLs and speakers preserved; GPL-3.0-or-later.
sources.m10_r16_modifications: M10-R16: anterior side bracing and central groove continue to the tongue tip; positive bracing contacts the native hull, negative relief follows native material stations. Surface, sections and equivalent tube recomputed together. Layout m10/3, geometry method m10/r16. Original API DLLs and speakers preserved; GPL-3.0-or-later.
sources.m10_r17_modifications: M10-R17: bound inward blade depression relative to moving body/tip support (3 mm geometric regularizer), smooth blend, geometric narrow-gap profiles shared by acoustic integration and display and cached per pose; empirical area corrections and genuine closure retained. Method m10/r17, layout m10/3. Original synthesis/analysis DLLs and speakers preserved; GPL-3.0-or-later.
sources.m10_r18_modifications: M10-R18: compact arc-length local dorsal offsets before native hard-tissue contact; material handle station exported; zero offsets preserve R17 geometry digests in six reference poses. Method m10/r18, layout m10/3. Original synthesis DLLs and speakers retained; GPL-3.0-or-later.
